samples.summary: New "a merged block may not straddle a freeze boundary" invariant is enforced only on the paste path, not on the sibling drag-move path
samples.evidence: This delta promotes the freeze-boundary rule from a `canMergeSelection` button guard to a model invariant (`crossesFreezePane`, refusal `merge-paste-frozen`, documented in docs/design/sheets/sheet.md as "the rule ... the renderer assumes when it paints a frozen pane and the scrolling body from a single block"). `moveRangeTo` (sheet.ts:2650-2670) is the operation the paste rules are explicitly modelled on (`merge-source-split` / `merge-dest-partial`), yet it still relocates merged blocks with no `crossesFreezePane` check, so a drag-move can create exactly the straddling block the paste now refuses. Same for `setFreezePane` (sheet.ts:513), which can drop a freeze line through an existing merge. The invariant as stated in the design doc is therefore only half-enforced; cost stays a rendering/consistency wart rather than a lost acceptance criterion.

samples.summary: Task plan not updated for the two new decisions this delta makes (freeze-boundary refusal, snapshot-vs-live merge rule)
samples.evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:13-16,63-66 requires a per-task plan under docs/tasks/active/ alongside the design doc for non-trivial changes, and this PR's plan (docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md) has an explicit "Decisions" + checkbox "Plan" section that already records finer points (cut-block exclusion, single-cell exemption, external-paste policy). The delta adds a brand-new refusal reason `merge-paste-frozen` and a new snapshot-vs-live-merge rule (`liveMergesAmong`), neither of which appears anywhere in the plan; only docs/design/sheets/sheet.md was updated. The scope of #936 as written in the plan does not mention freeze panes at all, so a reader of the task plan cannot tell why the paste gained a freeze rule.

samples.summary: `rangeOf` spread-to-fold rewrite (plus a 200k-cell test) is adjacent scope carried in a merge-propagation PR
samples.evidence: The task plan's only `rangeOf` item is "[x] `selectPastedRange` uses `rangeOf` instead of its own bounding box" (line 79); this delta additionally rewrites `rangeOf`'s implementation for argument-limit safety. It is a defensible consequence of routing pastes through `rangeOf` (sheet.ts:2606), so this is noted as adjacent scope rather than a violation — but it is a behavior-class change (crash avoidance on large pastes) with no mention in the plan or design doc.
